comments.value:
I have a very similar issue, it happened since i moved over a month ago and got new internet which was a downgrade from fiber to cable with a new ISP on a new non-ISP provided modem.

I've somewhat narrowed down the problem to either ports or IPV6 issues, i forwarded a bunch, and disabled my PC's IPV6, but that only resolved twitch streams and older AVPro player streams, the new video players with the 'Low-Latency' and 'Standard' options both have those choppy-to-dropping-completely issues.

I have recently started experiencing this issue aswell. rtspt club streams work for a few seconds after clicking the resync button, only to stop with the error "[AVProVideo] Error: Loading failed.  File not found, codec not supported, video resolution too high or insufficient system resources.". It does not manage to reconnect most of the time, I have to press the resync button everytime it fails.

- No issues when l open the rtsp link externally via VLC while in a club

- I performed a fresh install of Windows 11, issue persists

- I tried the following launch parameters: --disable-hw-video-decoding --main-thread-priority=2 --process-priority=2

- Twitch livestream links worked flawlessly

- https livestreams worked fine such as an https://stream.vrcdn.live link, only rtspt://stream.vrcdn.live keeps having this issue.

Using an RTX 2070 Max-Q, Intel Core i7 10750H, 64gb of ram (Laptop)

My Router/Modem device died last week so i had to go get a new one which has fixed the issue.  The VRCDN streams are working fine now.  It seems like the Router/Modem must have been dying over the last few months and that is what caused the issue..  Thank you for your responses.

details:
The issue started over a month ago.  I have been listening to DJs in VRChat for years without issue until now. 

The issue is that in VRChat the VRCDN stream is choppy and then stops playing: this happens right away after joining a world and when resyncing doesn't help.  This happens when in PCVR and Desktop mode.

I used the VRChat VRCDN test world and i am able to play the fmp4 link but when i play the RTSPT link i get the choppy and then dies again.

The only error from the vrchat log file from my tests in the vrcdn test world is this: 

2024.08.14 23:26:19 Error      -  [AVProVideo] Error: Loading failed.  File not found, codec not supported, video resolution too high or insufficient system resources.

I am able to play the RTSPT link from FFmpeg from the command line on my computer and it plays fine.

I am able to ping VRCDN just fine

ping stream.vrcdn.live

Pinging stream.vrcdn.live [x.x.x.x] with 32 bytes of data:

Reply from x.x.x.x: bytes=32 time=35ms TTL=51

Reply from x.x.x.x: bytes=32 time=31ms TTL=51

Reply from x.x.x.x: bytes=32 time=32ms TTL=51

Reply from x.x.x.x: bytes=32 time=31ms TTL=51

Ping statistics for x.x.x.x:

    Packets: Sent = 4, Received = 4, Lost = 0 (0% loss),

Approximate round trip times in milli-seconds:

    Minimum = 31ms, Maximum = 35ms, Average = 32ms

I have gigabit internet that is connect with an ethernet cable.  My computer has a 4090 graphics, a 7950X3D processor, 128 GB of ram.  Windows and graphics card drivers are up to date.  Resources are not maxed out when the streams fail to play.

Let me know if i can provide any additional information or testing.

Thank you for the help.
title: VRCDN Streams are choppy and stop playing
